22276-despair-s-last-journey.title: Despair S Last Journey
22276-despair-s-last-journey.creator: David Christie Murray
22276-despair-s-last-journey.description: A book by David Christie Murray. s weary work for most of them. They stuck to it manfully and woman-fully, with abysmal furtive yawns; but the skirmish between the conductor and their fellow-passenger came as a sort of godsend, and when the transfer of a dollar bill, incredibly dirty and greasy and tattered, had brought warfare to a close, they still had the voluntary exile to stare at.

arxiv-2107-06068.title: Calibrated Uncertainty for Molecular Property Prediction using Ensembles of Message Passing Neural Networks
arxiv-2107-06068.creator: Jonas Busk, Peter Bjørn Jørgensen, Arghya Bhowmik, Mikkel N. Schmidt, Ole Winther, Tejs Vegge
arxiv-2107-06068.description: Abstract Data-driven methods based on machine learning have the potential to accelerate computational analysis of atomic structures. In this context, reliable uncertainty estimates are important for assessing confidence in predictions and enabling decision making. However, machine learning models can produce badly calibrated uncertainty estimates and it is therefore crucial to detect and handle uncertainty carefully.

arxiv-2111-02087.title: Antenna De-Embedding in FDTD Using Spherical Wave Functions by Exploiting Orthogonality
arxiv-2111-02087.creator: Leonardo Mörlein 1 , Lukas Berkelmann 1 , Dirk Manteuffel 1
arxiv-2111-02087.description: Abstract De-embedding antennas from the channel using Spherical Wave Functions (SWF) is a useful method to reduce the numerical effort in the simulation of wearable antennas. In this paper an analytical solution to the De-embedding problem is presented in form of surface integrals.

arxiv-2201-04975.title: Faster Counting and Sampling Algorithms using Colorful Decision Oracle
arxiv-2201-04975.creator: Anup Bhattacharya, Arijit Bishnu, Arijit Ghosh, Gopinath Mishra

arxiv-2206-14115.title: Quantum Neural Architecture Search with Quantum Circuits Metric and Bayesian Optimization
arxiv-2206-14115.creator: Trong DuongKAIST trongduong@kaist.ac.kr, Sang T. TruongStanford University sttruong@cs.stanford.edu, Minh TamAalto University minh.phamnguyen@aalto.fi, Bao BachHCMUT bao.bachbbace12@hcmut.edu.vn Ju-Young RyuKAIST jyryu98@kaist.ac.kr June-Koo Kevin RheeKAIST rhee.jk@kaist.edu
arxiv-2206-14115.description: Abstract Quantum neural networks are promising for a wide range of applications in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum era. As such, there is an increasing demand for automatic quantum neural architecture search. We tackle this challenge by designing a quantum circuits metric for Bayesian optimization with Gaussian process.

arxiv-2209-04698.title: Structured Q-learning For Antibody Design
arxiv-2209-04698.creator: Alexander I. Cowen-Rivers, Philip John Gorinski, Aivar Sootla, Asif Khan, Furui Liu, Jun Wang, Jan Peters, Haitham Bou Ammar
arxiv-2209-04698.description: Abstract Optimizing combinatorial structures is core to many real-world problems, such as those encountered in life sciences. For example, one of the crucial steps involved in antibody design is to find an arrangement of amino acids in a protein sequence that improves its binding with a pathogen.

arxiv-2302-02081.title: Testing Neutrino Dipole Portal by Long-lived Particle Detectors at the LHC
arxiv-2302-02081.creator: Wei Liu, Yu Zhang
arxiv-2302-02081.description: Abstract We discuss the potential of using detectors aimed for searching long-lived particles (LLP) at the high-luminosity LHC run, to probe the neutrino dipole models. This is achieved by taking the heavy neutral leptons (HNL) of the models as candidates of the LLPs.

arxiv-2302-03613.title: Discrete One-dimensional Models for the Electromomentum Coupling
arxiv-2302-03613.creator: Kevin Muhafra, Michael R. Haberman, Gal Shmuel
arxiv-2302-03613.description: Abstract Willis dynamic homogenization theory revealed that the effective linear momentum of elastic composites is coupled to their effective strain. Recent generalization of Willis’ dynamic homogenization theory to the case of piezoelectric composites further revealed that their effective linear momentum is also coupled to the effective electric field.

arxiv-2407-06739.title: Grids of stellar models with rotation
arxiv-2407-06739.creator: Yves Sibony, Kendall G. Shepherd, Norhasliza Yusof, Raphael Hirschi, Caitlan Chambers, Sophie Tsiatsiou, Devesh Nandal, Luca Sciarini, Facundo D. Moyano, Jérôme Bétrisey, Gaël Buldgen Cyril Georgy, Sylvia Ekström, Patrick Eggenberger, Georges Meynet
arxiv-2407-06739.description: Abstract Context. Grids of stellar evolution models with rotation using the Geneva stellar evolution code ( Genec ) have been published for a wide range of metallicities. Aims. We introduce the last remaining grid of Genec models, with a metallicity of Z = 10 − 5 Z=10^{-5} .

arxiv-2410-23833.title: Performance tests and hardware qualification of the FEBs for the Super-FGD of T2K Phase II
arxiv-2410-23833.creator: and F. Sánchez
arxiv-2410-23833.description: Abstract T2K is a long baseline neutrino experiment, entering Phase II with a Near Detector upgrade. The T2K near detector (ND280) upgrade consists of the installation of three new detector systems: a plastic scintillator neutrino active target (Super-FGD), two time projection chambers (HA-TPC) and a time of flight detector (TOF).

arxiv-2411-18368.title: Amps : ASR with Multimodal Paraphrase Supervision
arxiv-2411-18368.creator: Abhishek Gupta Amruta Parulekar Sameep Chattopadhyay Preethi JyothiIndian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai, India {abhishekumgupta,amrutaparulekar.iitb,sameep.ch.2002}@gmail.com, pjyothi@cse.iitb.ac.in
arxiv-2411-18368.description: Abstract Spontaneous or conversational multilingual speech presents many challenges for state-of-the-art automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. In this work, we present a new technique Amps that augments a multilingual multimodal ASR system with paraphrase-based supervision for improved conversational ASR in multiple languages, including Hindi, Marathi, Malayalam, Kannada, and Nyanja.

arxiv-2503-23946.title: Inflated G G -Extensions for Algebraic Number Fields
arxiv-2503-23946.creator: M Krithika, VIT University, Chennai
arxiv-2503-23946.description: Abstract In 2018, Legrand and Paran proved a weaker form of the Inverse Galois Problem for all Hilbertian fields and all finite groups : that is, there exist possibly non-Galois extensions over given Hilbertian base field with given finite group as the group of field automorphisms fixing the base field. For 𝐐 \mathbf{Q} it was proved earlier by M. Fried.

arxiv-2509-01430.title: Natal kicks of compact objects Journal: New Astronomy Reviews
arxiv-2509-01430.creator: Sergei Popov, Bernhard Müller, Ilya Mandel
arxiv-2509-01430.description: Abstract When compact objects – neutron stars and black holes – are formed in a supernova explosion, they may receive a high velocity at formation, which may reach or even exceed ≈ 1000 \approx{1000} km s -1 for neutron stars and hundreds of km s -1 for black holes. The origin of the kick is intimately related to supernova physics.

arxiv-2509-23364.title: AI-Assisted Music Production: A User Study on Text-to-Music Models
arxiv-2509-23364.creator: Francesca Ronchini, Luca Comanducci, Simone Marcucci, Fabio Antonacci
arxiv-2509-23364.description: Abstract Text-to-music models have revolutionized the creative landscape, offering new possibilities for music creation. Yet their integration into musicians’ workflows remains underexplored. This paper presents a case study on how TTM models impact music production, based on a user study of their effect on producers’ creative workflows. Participants produce tracks using a custom tool combining TTM and source separation models.

arxiv-2511-05600.title: Google-MedGemma Based Abnormality Detection in Musculoskeletal radiographs
arxiv-2511-05600.creator: Soumyajit Maity, Pranjal Kamboj, Sneha Maity, Rajat Singh, Sankhadeep Chatterjee
arxiv-2511-05600.description: Abstract This paper proposed a MedGemma based framework for automatic abnormality detection in musculoskeletal radiographs. Departing from conventional autoencoder and neural network based pipelines, the proposed method leverages the MedGemma foundation model, incorporating a SigLIP derived vision encoder pretrained on diverse medical imaging modalities.

arxiv-2602-22778.title: Generating entangled polaritonic condensates by pumping with entangled pairs of photons
arxiv-2602-22778.creator: N.A. Asriyan, A.A. Elistratov, A.V. Kavokin
arxiv-2602-22778.description: Abstract We investigate the steady state of two single-mode uniform spatially separated polaritonic condensates exposed to resonant pumping with entangled pairs of photons. We demonstrate the principal possibility of driving the system to an entangled state despite its exposure to noises arising from the excitonic reservoir and photon leakage through the microcavity mirrors.

arxiv-2605-16701.title: What’s Inside a GitHub Repository? An Empirical Study on the Contents of 10K Projects
arxiv-2605-16701.creator: Andre Hora, João Eduardo Montandon, Diego Elias Costa

pmc-10542375.title: Ballistic transport spectroscopy of spin-orbit-coupled bands in monolayer graphene on WSe2
pmc-10542375.creator: Qing Rao, Wun-Hao Kang, Hongxia Xue, Ziqing Ye, Xuemeng Feng, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Ning Wang, Ming-Hao Liu, Dong-Keun Ki
pmc-10542375.description: Van der Waals interactions with transition metal dichalcogenides were shown to induce strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC) in graphene, offering great promises to combine large experimental flexibility of graphene with unique tuning capabilities of the SOC. Here, we probe SOC-driven band splitting and electron dynamics in graphene on WSe2 by measuring ballistic transverse magnetic focusing.

pmc-10557193.title: Association mapping in bambara groundnut [Vigna subterranea (L.) Verdc.] reveals loci associated with agro-morphological traits
pmc-10557193.creator: Charles U. Uba, Happiness O. Oselebe, Abush A. Tesfaye, Wosene G. Abtew
pmc-10557193.description: BackgroundGenome-wide association studies (GWAS) are important for the acceleration of crop improvement through knowledge of marker-trait association (MTA). This report used DArT SNP markers to successfully perform GWAS on agro-morphological traits using 270 bambara groundnut [Vigna subterranea (L.) Verdc.] landraces sourced from diverse origins.

pmc-10574752.title: The Microbial Degradation of Natural and Anthropogenic Phosphonates
pmc-10574752.creator: Francesca Ruffolo, Tamara Dinhof, Leanne Murray, Erika Zangelmi, Jason P. Chin, Katharina Pallitsch, Alessio Peracchi
pmc-10574752.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Phosphonates are compounds containing a direct carbon–phosphorus (C–P) bond, which is particularly resistant to chemical and enzymatic degradation. They are environmentally ubiquitous: some of them are produced by microorganisms and invertebrates, whereas others derive from anthropogenic activities. Because of their chemical stability and potential toxicity, man-made phosphonates pose pollution problems, and many studies have tried to identify biocompatible systems for their elimination.

pmc-11456800.title: CAR-T cell therapy: Advances in digestive system malignant tumors
pmc-11456800.creator: Nan Xu, Zhonglin Wu, Jun Pan, Xiao Xu, Qiang Wei
pmc-11456800.description: Malignant tumors of the digestive system have had a notoriously dismal prognosis throughout history. Immunotherapy, radiotherapy, surgery, and chemotherapy are the primary therapeutic approaches for digestive system cancers. The rate of recurrence and metastasis, nevertheless, remains elevated. As one of the immunotherapies, chimeric antigen receptor T cell (CAR-T) therapy has demonstrated a promising antitumor effect in hematologic cancer.

pmc-11474574.title: Bidirectional Two-Sample Mendelian Randomization Analysis Reveals Causal Associations Between Modifiable Risk Factors and Fibromyalgia
pmc-11474574.creator: Wei Zu, Shaojiong Zhou, Tao Du, Chenyanwen Zhu, Siyue Nie, Hongwei Zhu
pmc-11474574.description: IntroductionThis study aims to investigate the potential causal effects of modifiable risk factors on Fibromyalgia (FM).MethodsGenetic variants associated with 34 exposure factors were obtained from Genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Summary statistics for FM were acquired from the FinnGen consortium. Bidirectional Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis was conducted between all exposures and outcomes.

pmc-11479212.title: Knockdown of SlYTHDF2 Accelerates Dark–Induced Tomato Leaf Senescence by Affecting the ABA Pathway
pmc-11479212.creator: Xinru Chen, Zihan Gao, Yangyang Li, Xiaoqian Nie, Qiaoli Xie, Guoping Chen, Zongli Hu
pmc-11479212.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). N6–methyladenosine (m6A) is a widespread post–transcriptional modification in eukaryotic mRNAs. Proteins with the YTH structural domain act as m6A–binding proteins by recognizing the m6A modification and regulating mRNA through this recognition. In this study, SlYTHDF2, a prototypical m6A –binding protein gene in the YTH family was expressed in various tissues, and subcellular localization analyses indicated that the SlYTHDF2 protein was localized in the nucleus and cytoplasm.

pmc-12509369.title: Bridging ethical gaps in digital health research: a framework for informed consent aligned with NIH guidance
pmc-12509369.creator: Rahma Rizky Alifia, Malihe Sadeghi, Maheswari Eluru, Mohammad Jafari, Maria Adela Grando
pmc-12509369.description: BackgroundDigital health technologies, including mobile applications, wearable devices, and sensors, are rapidly transforming clinical research. However, current informed consent practices often fall short of addressing the unique ethical risks introduced by these technologies. This study aims to develop and assess a comprehensive ethical consent framework to improve transparency, equity, and participant protection in digital health research.

pmc-12567747.title: Epidemiology and Evolution of Bovine Viral Diarrhea Virus (BVDV) in Uruguay: A 10-Year Study
pmc-12567747.creator: Leticia Maya, Matias Castells, Caroline Silveira, Federico Giannitti, Ingryd Merchioratto, Maria Barrandeguy, Alejo Menchaca, Rodney Colina, Enrica Sozzi
pmc-12567747.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Bovine viral diarrhea virus (BVDV) is a pathogen of worldwide economic importance. In Uruguay, BVDV is endemic, with seroprevalence >80% at the farm level. This study analyzed 912 samples collected from January 2018 to October 2024 by reverse transcription PCR and sequencing, from calves with diarrhea, aborted fetuses, heifers with a history of abortions, and animals exhibiting symptoms of Mucosal Disease. This work summarizes ten years (2014–2024) of molecular epidemiology and evolution of BVDV.

pmc-13202489.title: Changes in Stimulant Use Over Time Among Men Who Have Sex with Men in Philadelphia, Baltimore, and Washington, DC, 2008–2023
pmc-13202489.creator: Danielle German, Tanner Nassau, Karine Yenokyan, Xinyi Li, Sydney Bornstein, Kate Drezner, Taylor Hoj, Molly Gribbin, Colin Flynn, Kathleen A. Brady, Irene Kuo
pmc-13202489.description: Stimulant use among men who have sex with men (MSM) can contribute to HIV risk and care challenges. Monitoring and responding to local trends are critical for Ending the HIV Epidemic (EHE) initiatives. We assessed stimulant use patterns in Baltimore, Philadelphia, and Washington, DC from 2008 to 2023 using National HIV Behavioral Surveillance data.

pmc-13328033.title: From companion animals to patients: interspecies lessons in neuroendocrine oncology
pmc-13328033.creator: Fernanda Cristina Poscai Ribeiro, Rodrigo A. Maioral, Victoria Cristina Mendonça Fujimoto, Gabriele Drigo Galan, Jaqueline Bastos-Lebold, Gary Chris Fillmore, Heloisa P. Soraes, Erika Said Abu Egal

pmc-13466243.title: Prognostic Significance of B7-H3 Expression and CD163+ Tumor-Associated Macrophage Infiltration in Mesothelioma
pmc-13466243.creator: Tülay Koç, Ramazan Oğuz Yüceer, Tuncay Altay, Neslihan Taş, Serkan Çelikgün
pmc-13466243.description: Mesothelioma is a rare, aggressive malignancy with poor prognosis. B7-H3 (CD276), an immune checkpoint molecule, and CD163-positive tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) contribute to tumor progression and immune evasion. This study evaluated the prognostic impact of B7-H3 expression and CD163-positive TAM infiltration. This single-center retrospective study included 94 patients diagnosed with malignant mesothelioma between 2011 and 2024.

pmc-13560448.title: Spatial proteomics reveals four-stage molecular evolution in cancer immunotherapy-related gastritis
pmc-13560448.creator: Lei Shi, Zhongqiao Lin, Huishan Zhang, Yuping Lu, Zequn Sun, Bin Lan, Huang Xia, Shuimei Luo, Ling Chen, Zhida Wu, Yuyang Huang, Mengru Quan, Xuefeng Wang, Jing Lin, Yu Chen
pmc-13560448.description: BackgroundImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed cancer treatment, yet immune-related adverse events (irAEs) including immunotherapy-related gastritis (IRAEG) pose significant clinical challenges—often necessitating treatment interruption that may compromise antitumor efficacy. IRAEG presents with atypical symptoms, lacks specific biomarkers, and shows histopathological overlap with other forms of gastritis, complicating diagnosis and management.
